variants.headline: Bid to remove government fails
variants.body: A vote to bring down the government has failed in {colony}. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: Confidence challenge falls short
variants.body: The attempt to remove the government by an Assembly vote has failed. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: Government survives the Assembly test
variants.body: The government has survived a vote intended to bring it down. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.
